note: What a remote may ask the main for crew server discord send: crew voice discord _send <stage id> (the main's link adds --source) and crew voice discord status. Both sides check it: voiceos/src/remote/query-allow.ts before the main runs crew, crew/cmd_server_discord.go parseDiscordSendStagedArgs when it does; crew builds the argv with voice.DiscordSendQuery and voice.DiscordStatusQuery. A remote names only a stage id, never a path.
